note: T1-T10 structures seen in the breakout research (346 hashtag reels, 300 reels from 20 accounts, 2026-10-15/16). Examples are ORIGINAL wording and must never be copied into a reel - lint_short rejects any 6+-word overlap with them. Write new wording every time.
hook_first: The hook (beat 1) is on screen at frame 0 and must work as the setup on its own.
topic_rule: Humour targets the BEHAVIOUR or the SITUATION, never the person, never a diagnosis, medication, self-harm or suicide. No joke may trivialise mental illness.
topics: reading a text five times before answering
being fine alone, quiet in groups

templates.example: People think I'm ignoring them. I'm drafting a reply. It's been three hours.
templates.send_trigger: the friend who takes hours to reply

templates.example: Confidence before pressing send. / Regret at "delivered".
